mapper.select: SELECT E.EVENT_ID eventId , E.COMPANY_NAME companyName , E.EVENT_TITLE eventTitle , E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS maxParticipants , COUNT(P.EVENT_ID) currentParticipants , ROUND(COUNT(P.EVENT_ID) / NULLIF(E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, 0) * 100, 2) participationRate , 0 participated FROM CL_EVENT E LEFT JOIN CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON E.EVENT_ID = P.EVENT_ID WHERE E.EVENT_ID = 1 GROUP BY E.EVENT_ID , E.COMPANY_NAME , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS

SELECT E.EVENT_ID eventId , E.COMPANY_NAME companyName , E.EVENT_TITLE eventTitle , E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS maxParticipants , COUNT(P.EVENT_ID) currentParticipants , ROUND(COUNT(P.EVENT_ID) / NULLIF(E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS, 0) * 100, 2) participationRate , 0 participated FROM CL_EVENT E LEFT JOIN CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT P ON E.EVENT_ID = P.EVENT_ID WHERE E.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} GROUP BY E.EVENT_ID , E.COMPANY_NAME , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.MAX_PARTICIPANTS
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT ( PARTICIPANT_ID , EVENT_ID , MEMBER_NO , PARTICIPATED_AT ) VALUES ( CL_EVENT_PARTICIPANT_SEQ.NEXTVAL , #{eventId} , #{memberNo} , SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_EVENT SET CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS = CURRENT_PARTICIPANTS + 1 WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
